card.name: Years and dates in biographies
card.fires_on: Digits inside a year, and nearby words like retirement or was, in short biographical notes about careers. Also the dash in page ranges of citations.

modes.label: Digits inside years
modes.description: A digit partway through a four-digit year in a career timeline.
modes.example: In 1<<9>>61 he became director of Stuttgart Ballet

modes.label: Career-event words near a year
modes.description: Words like retirement, was, or on that follow a year in a biography.
modes.example: at Harvard from 1927 until his<< retirement>> in 1974.

modes.label: Citation page-range dash
modes.description: The dash between page numbers in a reference.

card.writes: No clear link to a particular word; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on years and dates inside short life-story summaries of scholars and artists.
